versions.content: If the filtering of TCP options has been enabled on a socket via TcpIp_ChangeParameter(), the TcpIp shall check received segments against the allowed list of options ( ECUC_TcpIp_00202 : TcpIpTcpConfigOptionFilter) and if it contains at least one TCP option not liste d the segment shall be silently discarded .
